fields.Name: W1 -> S7.5
fields.Description: Gate G0.1 (owner PR 2, phase 0, dataset W1, criterion S7.5): on W1-signal s42, training with the UI default reads all 16,776 labelled rows (training + locked holdout) or is refused with READ_CAP_EXCEEDED, and a filter-scope ScoreRecordSet call scores all 16,776 rows or is refused with READ_CAP_EXCEEDED. Refusal is read from the operation's result code.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Training reads 16,776 of 16,776 rows or refuses with READ_CAP_EXCEEDED; filter scoring scores 16,776 of 16,776 or refuses with READ_CAP_EXCEEDED.
